segments.court: a specific state/house court and senior officials
segments.military_officers: officer corps of a specific state/army
segments.rank_and_file: ordinary soldiers inside a specific military network
segments.commoners: public population of a specific settlement/region/state
segments.mercenary_market: mercenary employers, brokers, captains, and companies sharing contract information
segments.border_local: population/officials along a specific frontier or route
segments.enemy_intelligence: a specific hostile intelligence/command network, never a generic omniscient enemy

rules: Audience membership/knowledge is resolved from current institution, role, location, information access, and saved social links.
Do not create a world-public audience that automatically knows all public events.
One person may participate in multiple audiences; use only audiences they can actually access.
